channel.title: Electrical equipment: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the electrical equipment sector.

item.title: GnCenergy: GnCenergy signed a KRW 33.6bn contract with CJ Logistics to supply gas turbine generators for the Ansan AIDC project.
Doosan Fuel Cell: Doosan Fuel Cell signs KRW 48.0bn, 10-year long-term maintenance agreement for fuel cell systems with Naepo Green Energy.
PNC Technologies: PNC Technologies' market capitalisation has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days, raising risk of administrative issue designation.
SCD: SCD's common stock has closed below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days as of 25 November 2026, raising administrative issue designation risk.
Seojin System: Seojin System signs KRW 165.6bn SOFC module and parts supply contract with Bloom Energy Corporation for delivery to the US.
GnCenergy: GnCenergy signed a KRW 39.36bn contract with DL E&C to supply gas turbine emergency generators and related equipment for the Gimpo data center.
TAIHAN Fiberoptics: TAIHAN Fiberoptics board decides to absorb wholly owned subsidiary TFO Networks in a small-scale merger with no new shares issued.
Apro: Apro to absorb wholly owned subsidiary Greenbolt Pickle No.1 in a small-scale merger without issuing new shares
Seojeon Electric Machinery: Seojeon Electric signed a KRW 7.49bn contract with Hyundai Engineering & Construction for switchgear and distribution panels.
Sunam: Sunam board decides on a KRW 3.0bn public offering of 1,857,585 new common shares at KRW 1,615 per share.
Carry: Carry discloses a criminal complaint by an inside director alleging breach of trust by its CEO over a KRW 5.4bn loan.
Carry: Carry discloses criminal complaint against its CEO and executives alleging KRW 4.28bn embezzlement and breach of trust via short-term loans.
VitzroSys: VitzroSys common stock trading halted on 17 November 2026 due to a capital reduction, until market close.
VitzroSys: VitzroSys board decides a 3-to-1 free capital reduction of common shares, cutting issued shares from 12,590,616 to 4,196,872.
Kyung Dong Navien: Kyungdong Navien's Q3 2026 revenue rose 24.9% YoY to KRW 382.4bn, while it posted a net loss of KRW 2.4bn.
Seojin System: Seojin System's board decided on Nov 6, 2026 to issue KRW 60.0bn of Series 45 private-placement convertible bonds to fund acquisition of other companies' securities.
Seojin System: Seojin System decided to issue KRW 60.0bn of Series 44 unsecured private-placement convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 33,430.
TC Materials: TC Materials decided to issue KRW 30.0bn in second-series private convertible bonds, with a conversion price of KRW 4,290 per share.
Seondo Electric: Sundo Electric signed a KRW 8.85bn installation contract with SK hynix for the Yongin Y1 Ph-2 MCC/MCP project.
Seondo Electric: Sundo Electric signed a KRW 6.34bn contract with Korea Rail Network Authority for 29kV eco-friendly switchgear on the Honam High-Speed Railway Phase 2.
